name: delete_method
desc: Method to use for delete operation. If not specified, DELETE is used

name: delete_parameters
desc: Query parameters for DELETE API if any; format is key1=value1&key2=value2

name: delete_payload
desc: Payload to send for delete operation. Ignored if the method is `DELETE`. This field supports Text/template. Use `{{.field_name}}` to refer to a field from the `response_message`

name: delete_url
desc: URL to be used for delete operation. If not specified, the same URL as the create URL is used

name: payload
desc: Payload to send for CREATE/UPDATE operations

name: read_url
desc: URL to be used for GET(Read) operation. If not specified Read does not query NDFC This field supports Text/template. Use `{{.field_name}}` to refer to a field from the `response_message` The response from the GET operation is used to overwrite `payload` Note: The GET response must be an exact match of `payload`

name: stateful
desc: Stateful set to true triggers update only when something changes in config. If set to false every plan shows changes

name: update_method
desc: Method to use for update operation. PUT is used if not specified

name: update_payload
desc: Payload to send for update operation. If not specified, the same payload as the create payload is used. This field supports Text/template. Use `{{.field_name}}` to refer to a field from the `response_message`

name: update_url
desc: URL to be used for update operation. If not specified, the same URL as the create URL is used. This field supports Text/template. Use `{{.field_name}}` to refer to a field from the `response_message`

name: url
desc: URL to be used for operations - mainly CREATE
